title: Reasoning (think) block in the assistant turn
notes: Two exchanges, each assistant turn with reasoning in reasoning_content (the field Qwen3, Inkling and Hy4 templates read). Many templates drop the first turn's reasoning once a later user message exists, which is the main thing this fixture exercises.

messages.reasoning_content: 91 is odd and its digits sum to 10, so 2 and 3 do not divide it. 91 / 7 = 13, so 91 = 7 * 13.
messages.content: No. 91 = 7 * 13, so it is not prime.

messages.reasoning_content: 97 is not divisible by 2, 3, 5 or 7, and 11 * 11 = 121 is already larger than 97.
